predecessors.name: Colony of New South Wales
predecessors.text: 'between 132 degrees east and 141 degrees east, and south of 26 degrees south'

successors.name: Commonwealth of Australia
successors.text: South Australia, which 'then included the Northern Territory (transferred to the Commonwealth in 1911)'

ledger.x: 1836: South Australia is proclaimed at Glenelg (28 December 1836).
1861: the western boundary moves out to 129 E.

1863: South Australia takes the Northern Territory (6 July 1863): 'The New South Wales region north of South Australia was transferred to South Australia' (the Northern Territory); the History of the Northern Territory page: 'In 1863, the Northern Territory was annexed by South Australia by letters patent'.

1901: South Australia federates (1 January 1901): 'On 1 January 1901, these colonies, excepting New Zealand (who chose not to join), became states' of the Commonwealth; the Northern Territory is still part of South Australia until 1 January 1911.
